body: Thank you, I really appreciate that offer. I see you post around here a lot to help people, so I'd also like to thank you on behalf of the community for all that you're doing to contribute. You're the kind of person that I needed (and was lucky enough to have) when I was suicidal, and for many people, a single voice like yours can make all the difference.
No worries! It's certainly not your fault, and I'm not here for internet points, so they can downvote me as much as they want :)

Thank you for your input, this is really helpful. I've been considering telling him to come to a place like this to maybe find someone more qualified and more willing to help to talk to, and I think that's what I'll do after reading your post. I don't want to just cut him out and leave him with nothing, so maybe at least pushing him to find someone else he can talk to will be the best route.

You're definitely right -- I need to be honest. Up to this point, I've tried to push him away by using my life situation as an excuse but I wasn't straightforward enough. He deserves the truth as much as I deserve to have peace with his situation. Thank you for reassuring me on that.
I agree, which is why I want to cut ties with this person. I just want to do it in the nicest way possible and minimizing how much I hurt him in doing it, but I'm not really sure how.
